title: layr save --json
description: The result of a save, as one object per line of output. 'layr save -m <message> --json' (also with -a, --amend or -F) writes one object for a named save. 'layr save --json' and 'layr save --overlays --json' (automatic states) write one object for each line: one, or several with --all-lines. Files that the save left out are still named on stderr.

id.description: A layr id in UUID form.

short.description: The short form of a state id, as the text output prints it.

named.description: A named save that made a state ('layr save -m'). The exit status is 0.

state.description: The id of the new state. Null in a line with overlays when only overlays changed: then 'overlays' names the new overlay states.

short.description: The short id of 'state'. Null when 'state' is null.

parents.description: The ids of the parent states. Empty when 'state' is null.

amend.description: True for 'save --amend': the state replaced the head.

conflicts.description: The number of files of the state that still have conflict markers.

files.description: The numbers of the summary of the text output: the changes from the old head.

overlays.description: In a line with overlays: the new state of each overlay that the save changed.

items.description: The new state of one overlay.

state.description: The id of the new state in the overlay store.

nothing.description: A named save that found nothing to save. The exit status is 1, as with the text output.

reason.description: Why nothing was saved, in words for people.

automatic.description: An automatic state of one line ('layr save --json' without -m).

saved.description: False when the working folder did not change: then 'state' is the existing state.

state.description: The id of the state that is equal to the working folder.

overlays.description: The cache overlays that --overlays saved. Empty without it.

items.description: The new state of one cache overlay.

path.description: The cache folder in the line.

state.description: The id of the new state in the overlay store.
